_notes: Locally added for the leaderboards of VPX -- upstream pinmame-nvram-maps has no map for Spinball games.
Found by watching every byte of the RAM (0x8000-0x86FF) through an automated 2-player game (Doc/test-hooks/score-probe.py),
Scores: one digit per byte (low nibble), least significant digit first, 8 digits per player from 0x8400 (NVRAM). Player 1
rose from 70,002 to 449,020 and player 2 from 500 to 238,018 through the game; players 3 and 4 follow the stride, unchecked.
game_over 0x84AD: 0 during the game, 1 in attract mode (0x84D8 is its opposite). No player count found (0x8116 reads 1 then 3,
likely a mask of the players).
